purpose: We develop a model that predicts weight change during antidepressant treatment. Aggregated tables cannot capture each patient's trajectory over time, so we need patient-level records in a secure processing environment. Only model parameters will leave it.
question: Provide pseudonymised medications and observations of adults with depression who currently take sertraline.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Sertraline = active prescription with ATC code N06AB06.
Cohort = adults with depression and an active sertraline prescription.
Records: medications and observations of the cohort.
Report the number of patients in the cohort.
